**Vegetable Medley Soup** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

A vegetable soup comprised of various mixed and salted ingredients, such as Tatos and Carrots.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Boiled Water (2) Carrot (2) Salt (1) Tato (2) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned on use Vegetable Medley Soup | | Vegetable Medley Soup (1) | 

- One can be found in the bathroom of Sunnytop Station.
- Can be crafted at a Cooking Station after having consumed the vegetable medley soup for the first time.
- May be sold by Mr. Waiter at the dining room inside the Whitespring Resort.
- May be sold by Yasmin Chowdhury.
- Can be found in the Communist Collectron Station, when it is set to run in "Proletariat" mode.

Vegatable Medley Soup is, as of the Appalachian Modern Living update, the only consumable whose recipe is learned by ingesting it rather than picking it up or reading a Recipe.
